physicalChanges.exactRequestBinding: Every customer response is bound to the normalized requested asset, public limit and exact canonical cursor.
physicalChanges.crossRequestRejection: A self-consistent response for another asset, limit or cursor is rejected fail-closed.
physicalChanges.pageEvidence: The page evidence digest binds page source, resolution, canonical asset, request binding and ordered event references/timestamps.
physicalChanges.perPageStorageTruth: DATABASE and MEMORY are page-specific states; a process-global durable status cannot be inherited by another request.
physicalChanges.durabilityBoundary: Neither page source claims multi-year retention, PITR or backup/restore.
physicalChanges.multiPageBoundary: Merged pages must retain one asset reference, exact cursor chain, unique page references and one page source.
physicalChanges.customerWording: PL/EN/DE text describes database-page integrity or runtime-memory scope without durable-history overclaim.

cryptographicBoundary.purpose: closed request/page routing and integrity binding

truthBoundary: No-socket local/runtime/static/source proof only. SHA-256 references are not signatures. This does not prove deployed HTTP, PostgreSQL persistence, retention, restore, Browser, staging, production or real customer data.
